disposition: The safe conservative comparison is a rigged trace attachment, not equality H_wall=Dom(C_FP). C_FP keeps H1 inside the L2 pivot; the history-wall/Fourier orbit is its complete response carrier. This avoids an unnecessary and spectrum-changing domain extension. Owner adoption now requires an explicit graph-norm response trace and Green factorization.
